## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete trigger and what changes for users.

## Scope and compatibility

List affected components, any policy changes and preservation of existing behavior.

## Validation

Record commands actually executed and results. Include temporary-directory test coverage.

## Risk and recovery

Explain security/privacy, data integrity, cost implications, remaining limitations and rollback.

- [ ] Original standards are unchanged, or policy changes have explicit maintainer review.
- [ ] No secrets, private paths, local backups or unrelated application data are included.
- [ ] Real Claude Code/Codex installations were not modified by automated tests.
- [ ] No AI co-authorship trailers were added.
